courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鐵路號誌失效安全分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「道路使用者反應距離」與「區段偵測有效性」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路號誌失效安全分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Road-user reaction distance" and "Validity of section detection" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦平交道警示時序道路清空與界面整合；鐵路號誌失效安全分析則以號誌危害邏輯共同原因與證據鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on crossing-warning timing road clearance and interface integration; Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling centres on signalling hazard logic common causes and evidence chains, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「道路使用者反應距離」與「頂事件邏輯選擇」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路號誌失效安全分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「危害需求追溯」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Road-user reaction distance” and “Selecting top-event logic”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tracing hazards to requirements", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鐵路平交道警報聯動
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2006 年公路鐵路交會處的人因指引報告出版。；2019 年公路鐵路平交道手冊第三版出版。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對平交道警示時序道路清空與界面整合而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用道路車輛停止距離及警示失效原因樹連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2006: Human-factors guidance for highway–rail intersections was published. 2019: The third highway–rail crossing handbook edition was published. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For crossing-warning timing road clearance and interface integration, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through stopping distance of road vehicles and fault causes for warning failure. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
